conductor_id.description: Unique identifier for this conductor node (leave as 'auto' to auto-generate from hostname).

rpc_workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling RPC calls. Increase under high RPC load.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the HTTP API service. Increase for higher request throughput.

transport_url.description: RPC transport URL in the form 'driver://user:password@host:port//vhost'. Typically 'rabbit://' for RabbitMQ.

auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy for the conductor service ('keystone' or 'noauth'). Use 'noauth' only for testing.

default_ipmi_timeout.description: Default timeout (in seconds) for IPMI operations like power status polling or remote media mounting.

enable_inspector.description: Enable or disable the Ironic Inspector service integration (used for automated hardware introspection).

enable_api.description: Enable or disable the Ironic API endpoint on this conductor. Disable if running API-only on separate nodes.

my_ip.description: IP address or hostname of this conductor host (used for API endpoint registration). Leave 'auto' to detect automatically.

driver_http_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for HTTP requests made by drivers (e.g., to firmware update endpoints).

driver_http_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed HTTP requests made by drivers.

health_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks for conductor status reporting.

max_concurrent_builds.description: Maximum number of node provisioning (build) operations that may run concurrently on this conductor.

max_cleaning_timeout.description: Maximum expected time (in seconds) for cleaning operations (e.g., disk wiping). Increase for large disks.

max_raid_config_timeout.description: Maximum expected time (in seconds) for RAID configuration operations.

default_cleaning_disable.description: If true, disable automatic cleaning after deployment (requires manual cleaning).

enable_auto_clean.description: If true, automatically trigger cleaning when a node is de-provisioned.

default_management_interface.description: Default management interface used for power control, reboot, etc. (e.g., 'ipmi', 'redfish').

enabled_network_interfaces.description: List of enabled network interfaces for node configurations.

enabled_raid_interfaces.description: List of enabled RAID configuration interfaces.

enabled_power_interfaces.description: List of enabled power control interfaces.

enabled_provisioning_network_interfaces.description: List of enabled provisioning network interfaces.

enabled_inspect_interfaces.description: List of enabled inspection interfaces (deprecated; use 'enabled_inspection_interfaces').

enabled_inventory_interfaces.description: List of enabled hardware inventory collection interfaces.

enabled_provisioning_storage_interfaces.description: List of enabled storage interfaces for provisioning.

database_max_pool_size.description: Maximum size of the database connection pool.

neutron_auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy for Neutron API calls.

neutron_project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for Neutron authentication.

neutron_project_name.description: Keystone project name for Neutron authentication.

neutron_user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for Neutron authentication.

inspector_auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy for Ironic Inspector API.

keystone_interface.description: Keystone endpoint interface to use ('public', 'internal', or 'admin').

keystone_insecure.description: If true, disable TLS certificate verification for Keystone API calls.

api_flavor.description: PasteDeploy flavor for Ironic API ('keystone' or 'noauth').
